gloss: another day; some other time; in the future

definitions.gloss: another day; some other time; in the future
definitions.explanation: Refers to an unspecified day in the future. A formal, literary expression used in writing and polite speech.

examples.japanese: {他日|たじつ}お{会|あ}いしましょう。
{他日|たじつ}、{改|あらた}めてご{連絡|れんらく}いたします。
examples.english: I will contact you again on another occasion.

examples.japanese: {他日|たじつ}、この{経験|けいけん}が{役|やく}に{立|た}つ{日|ひ}が{来|く}るだろう。
examples.english: Someday in the future, the day will come when this experience proves useful.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal and somewhat literary word. In everyday speech, {別|べつ}の{日|ひ} (another day) or また{今度|こんど} (some other time) are more commonly used. {他日|たじつ} appears in formal correspondence and literary writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {他日|たじつ}を{期|き}す (to look forward to another occasion)
- {他日|たじつ}{改|あらた}めて (on another day, anew)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {後日|ごじつ}: at a later date — focuses on a specific future date
- いつか: someday — casual, everyday equivalent
